scope: Read-only geometric canvas picking and renderer gesture ownership; no author/source/schema/native/backend mutation. Real browser/GPU-pixel and packaged execution proof are reported separately by the parent.

frame.objects: source-ordered [{instanceId, model:<actual Float32 model uniform,16 values>}]

contract.surfaceSelection: Inverse near(-1)/middle(0) ray; transformed unit-box entry/exit real surfaces; homogeneous clip; minimum projected depth, later declaration wins exact equal depth matching existing LEQUAL.
contract.ownership: Renderer emits selection or focus hint only. UI owns selection approval and calls existing focusObject; renderer does not focus or change author source during hitTest/callback.
contract.gestures: Primary left single-pointer. Maximum displacement greater than 4 CSS px starts orbit and permanently removes tap eligibility for that gesture. Secondary pointer, cancel, unexpected lost capture, wheel, resize, model/reset/focus/context loss/dispose invalidate pending view gestures.
contract.normalCaptureLoss: Expected pointerup-driven release/lostpointercapture preserves qualified recent tap, including the native double-click sequence; active unexpected loss cancels.
contract.framePosition: Current CSS left/top are used with the same drawn Float32 matrices after ordinary scrolling without redraw. Changed CSS size or drawing allocation needs a fresh frame. Position changes during an active gesture or between approved tap and dblclick cancel that gesture.
contract.invalid: Missing/contextlost/disposed/unrendered/invalid matrix or coordinates return null and do not forward a callback.

limitations: CPU geometric selection from actual Float32 upload coefficients; no claim of GPU raster edge, anti-aliasing or quantized depth-buffer bit parity.
WebGL fixtures observe actual renderer uniform payloads and lifecycle calls; browser pixel/device execution requires the separate parent/UI proof.
No source-writing authority or native scene validation is introduced by this view-only frame DTO.
